How to Order

Ordering is simple.

1

Pick a style

Browse the sets above and choose the one you love.

2

Send a request

Send your request to us on Facebook and tell us which style you want.

3

Pick up

We will share the pickup details with you once we get your request. You need to be local or willing to drive to pick up. Pay with cash, Cash App or Venmo.

Custom Orders

Not buying a pre-made set? Here’s how to order nails made just for you.

1

Message us

Send us a message on Facebook with:

  • your nail sizes (how to size is just below)
  • the nail design you want
2

Get your price

We’ll tell you if we can make your design and give you a price.

Message us on Facebook

How to Size Your Nails

Use the Dime Method for the perfect fit. Send us these two photos with your order.

For the perfect fit

  • Take each photo from right above your nails, so we can measure every nail from sidewall to sidewall.
  • Lay your hand flat on a table.
  • Keep the dime in the photo: it shows us the size.

Good to Know

Handmade with care

Every set is made by hand, and made to be high quality so they look beautiful and last.

Local pickup only

Hails is a local business. Nails are not shipped, so you pick up your order yourself. Buyers need to be local or willing to drive to pick up their nails.

Requests on Facebook

Send your requests and questions to us on Facebook, so you can talk to us directly.

Easy payment

Pay with cash, Cash App or Venmo, whichever is easiest for you.
